Title: Supabase Service Role Key Exposed
Description: Service role key bypasses all Row Level Security policies
Recommendation: Rotate key immediately in Supabase dashboard; audit database logs; never commit this key

Title: NextAuth Secret Exposed
Description: Exposed secret allows session hijacking and token forgery
Recommendation: Generate new secret (openssl rand -base64 32); update production; invalidate sessions

Title: Supabase Access Token Exposed
Description: Personal access token grants management API access
Recommendation: Revoke token in Supabase dashboard; generate new token; review access logs

Title: Supabase Anon Key Exposed
Description: Production anon key committed to filesystem
Recommendation: Rotate key; ensure .env.local never committed

Title: CORS Wildcard Origin Allowed
Description: CORS allows all origins (*) if ALLOWED_ORIGINS not set
Recommendation: Set explicit ALLOWED_ORIGINS; never use wildcard in production

Title: Rate Limiting Not Applied
Description: Middleware exists but not used on any API routes
Recommendation: Apply withAuth to all routes; use Redis for production

Title: Open Redirect Vulnerability
Description: Unvalidated redirect_to parameter in auth callback
Recommendation: Validate redirect_to against allowlist

Title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
Description: No CSP header configured to prevent XSS attacks
Recommendation: Add CSP header to middleware

Title: Missing HSTS Header
Description: No Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS
Recommendation: Add HSTS header with max-age=31536000

Title: Information Disclosure in Health Endpoint
Description: Exposes NODE_ENV environment variable
Recommendation: Remove environment information in production

Title: CVE-2025-62522 Vite Vulnerability
Description: Files denied by server.fs.deny sent if URL ends with backslash on Windows
Recommendation: Update vite to 7.1.11

Title: pdfjs-dist 147 versions behind
Description: PDF parsing library significantly outdated (5.4.149 → 5.4.296)
Recommendation: Update to 5.4.296; test PDF parsing thoroughly

Title: @types/uuid deprecated
Description: Package no longer needed since uuid includes types
Recommendation: Remove @types/uuid from dependencies

Title: 31 Outdated Packages
Description: Multiple packages behind latest versions
Recommendation: Update packages using provided script

Title: XSS Vulnerability in Export Utility
Description: innerHTML used without sanitization in print functionality
Recommendation: Sanitize HTML with DOMPurify or use DOM manipulation

Title: 673 Console Statements
Description: Excessive console logging causes performance degradation and data leakage
Recommendation: Replace with structured logger from lib/utils/logger.ts

Title: analysis-repository.ts Too Large
Description: File is 2.7x recommended maximum size (1389 lines)
Recommendation: Split into 4 repositories by entity

Title: history/page.tsx Too Large
Description: Component is 2.3x recommended maximum size (1162 lines)
Recommendation: Extract into smaller components

Title: 11 Explicit any Type Usages
Description: Bypasses TypeScript type safety
Recommendation: Replace with proper types from existing interfaces

Title: 117 Async Functions Without Try-Catch
Description: Unhandled promise rejections can crash application
Recommendation: Add try-catch blocks or implement global error boundary

Title: Missing Input Validation on 5 API Routes
Description: API routes lack Zod validation
Recommendation: Use withValidation middleware consistently

Title: No Password Strength Requirements
Description: Password requirements not enforced in code
Recommendation: Implement minimum password requirements (12 chars; complexity)

Title: No Account Lockout After Failed Logins
Description: Allows brute force attacks
Recommendation: Add account lockout after 5 failed attempts

Title: No Multi-Factor Authentication
Description: MFA not implemented
Recommendation: Consider implementing MFA for enhanced security

Title: Only 45% API Routes Protected
Description: 6 of 11 API routes lack authentication checks
Recommendation: Add authentication to all protected routes

Title: No Virus Scanning for Uploads
Description: Uploaded files not scanned for malware
Recommendation: Implement virus scanning (ClamAV or cloud service)

Title: Filenames Not Sanitized
Description: Path traversal risk in filename handling
Recommendation: Sanitize filenames to prevent path traversal

Title: 417 Uncommitted Changes
Description: Large uncommitted changeset suggests incomplete work
Recommendation: Create atomic commits for logical groups

Title: Documentation Sprawl
Description: 22 fix documentation files scattered at root
Recommendation: Move to docs/archive/fixes/

Title: Backup Files in Repository
Description: Test file backup should not be committed
Recommendation: Delete backup file

Title: Stale Branches
Description: 2 merged branches should be deleted
Recommendation: Delete merged branches (development_dashboard; refactor/analysis-components-cleanup)

Title: No Audit Logging
Description: Security events not logged for compliance
Recommendation: Implement audit logging for authentication; authorization; data access

Title: No Security Policy Documentation
Description: Policies not documented
Recommendation: Document security policies and procedures
